response.sql:
WITH profile_averages AS (
  SELECT o.weathprofile,
         AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
         COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1
  GROUP BY o.weathprofile
),
with_mean AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(avg_bandusagepct) OVER () AS mean_profile_average
  FROM profile_averages
)
SELECT weathprofile,
       avg_bandusagepct,
       telescope_count,
       avg_bandusagepct - mean_profile_average AS difference_from_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE mean_profile_average IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: The telescope count includes every matched telescope meeting the temperature threshold, including those with missing bandwidth usage; AVG ignores missing bandwidth values as requested.
